news.headline: India's Southwest Monsoon Ends 12.6% Below Normal, Marking Fourth-Lowest Rainfall Since 2001
news.story_lead: India's southwest monsoon concluded with a 12.6% deficit, recording 759.4 mm of rainfall from June to September. This marks the fourth-lowest monsoon rainfall since 2001, characterized by sharp regional variations and strengthening El Niño conditions. The combination of deficient rains and record-high September temperatures poses significant challenges for soil moisture and upcoming Rabi crop sowing.
news.full_article_text:
India's southwest monsoon ended with a 12.6% deficit, recording 759.4 mm of rain during the June-September period. According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), this is the fourth-lowest monsoon rainfall recorded in the country since 2001.

The monsoon was marked by sharp regional variations. East and Northeast India recorded a 25% deficit, South Peninsular India was 24% below normal, and Northwest India was 6% below normal. Central India remained broadly near normal with a 2% deficit. Several states faced severe shortfalls, including Arunachal Pradesh (44%), Punjab (41%), Assam and Meghalaya (39%), Marathwada (39%), Bihar (32%), and Kerala (28%). Overall, 17 meteorological subdivisions, covering 42% of the country's area, recorded deficient rainfall during the season, while 18 subdivisions covering 53% of the area had normal rainfall.

In addition to poor rainfall, September witnessed unusually high temperatures. The average maximum temperature over India was 32.05°C, the highest for September since 1901. The average minimum temperature of 23.39°C was the fourth-highest, and the mean temperature of 27.72°C was the fifth-highest since 1901.

This development comes as El Niño conditions strengthen. According to IMD Director General M Mohapatra, El Niño is likely to peak in November and then begin weakening. Consequently, the IMD expects below-normal rainfall (below 85% of the long-period average) for October, as well as below-normal rainfall for the October-December period across most of the country.

The combination of poor rainfall and high temperatures has left large tracts of the country with inadequate soil moisture. Experts warn that this spells serious trouble for Rabi sowing and overall crop prospects, particularly in rainfed areas of central, southern peninsular, eastern, and northeastern India.
news.background_context: The southwest monsoon is critical for India's agricultural economy, influencing both Kharif crop yields and Rabi sowing preparation. The strengthening of El Niño conditions has historically been associated with weaker monsoon performance and higher temperatures in the Indian subcontinent.
bullet_points: India's southwest monsoon ended with a 12.6% deficit, recording 759.4 mm of rain during June-September.
This rainfall level represents the fourth-lowest monsoon recorded in the country since 2001.

Strengthening El Niño conditions are expected to peak in November, leading to below-normal rainfall projections for October-December.
Inadequate soil moisture poses a serious threat to the upcoming Rabi sowing season, particularly in rainfed regions.

The uneven distribution of rainfall, with severe deficits in the East, Northeast, and South Peninsular regions, underscores the need for regional water management strategies. Furthermore, record-high temperatures in September exacerbate soil moisture depletion, threatening the Rabi sowing cycle. This situation calls for climate-resilient agricultural practices, improved irrigation infrastructure, and robust crop insurance mechanisms to safeguard rural livelihoods and food security.

hindi_translation.story_lead: भारत का दक्षिण-पश्चिम मानसून 12.6% की कमी के साथ समाप्त हुआ, जिसमें जून से सितंबर के दौरान 759.4 मिमी बारिश दर्ज की गई। यह 2001 के बाद से चौथी सबसे कम मानसूनी बारिश है, जो तीव्र क्षेत्रीय विविधताओं और मजबूत होते अल नीनो (El Niño) की स्थिति से प्रभावित रही। कम बारिश और सितंबर के रिकॉर्ड-उच्च तापमान के संयोजन ने मिट्टी की नमी और आगामी रबी फसलों की बुआई के लिए गंभीर चुनौतियां खड़ी कर दी हैं।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:

इस मानसून में तीव्र क्षेत्रीय विविधताएं देखी गईं। पूर्व और पूर्वोत्तर भारत में 25% की कमी, दक्षिण प्रायद्वीपीय भारत में 24% की कमी और उत्तर-पश्चिम भारत में 6% की कमी दर्ज की गई, जबकि मध्य भारत 2% की कमी के साथ लगभग सामान्य रहा। राज्यों में, अरुणाचल प्रदेश में 44%, पंजाब में 41%, असम और मेघालय में 39%, बिहार में 32% और केरल में 28% की कमी दर्ज की गई। कुल मिलाकर, देश के 42% क्षेत्र को कवर करने वाले 17 मौसम संबंधी उप-मंडलों में कम बारिश दर्ज की गई।

इसके अतिरिक्त, सितंबर में असामान्य रूप से उच्च तापमान दर्ज किया गया। भारत में औसत अधिकतम तापमान 32.05°C रहा, जो 1901 के बाद से सितंबर का सबसे गर्म महीना था। अल नीनो की स्थिति मजबूत हो रही है और इसके नवंबर में चरम पर पहुंचने की संभावना है। इसके कारण अक्टूबर से दिसंबर की अवधि में देश के अधिकांश हिस्सों में सामान्य से कम बारिश होने की उम्मीद है, जिससे मिट्टी की नमी प्रभावित होगी और रबी फसलों की बुआई के लिए गंभीर संकट पैदा हो सकता है।

जून-सितंबर के दौरान कुल 759.4 मिमी बारिश दर्ज की गई, जो 2001 के बाद चौथी सबसे कम है।

news.headline: India Issues Fresh Advisory for Citizens Following Recruitment Reports in Russian Armed Forces
news.story_lead: The Ministry of External Affairs has issued a fresh advisory urging Indian nationals to exercise caution and avoid unverified job offers abroad. The advisory comes in the backdrop of 51 Indian deaths while serving with the Russian military on the frontlines of the conflict in Ukraine.
news.full_article_text: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) issued a fresh advisory for Indian nationals travelling to Russia, highlighting the severe dangers faced by citizens recruited into Russia's armed forces, including hiring by non-public entities. The government stated it is actively engaged with the Russian side to secure the early discharge of remaining Indian citizens. According to recent figures shared by authorities, a total of 227 Indians have been recruited into the Russian military, out of which 139 have been discharged, 51 have died, and efforts continue for the remaining individuals. The advisory also cautioned against individuals willingly seeking out offers for monetary benefits or giving up Indian citizenship for Russian passports without consulting authorities, noting that the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) is currently probing fraudulent recruitment cases.
news.background_context: Reports of Indian nationals being recruited into Russia's military began to emerge about two years after the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Some individuals on tourist or student visas were reportedly lured with promises of large salaries and Russian citizenship, while others were illegally recruited through unscrupulous agents.

news.headline: Goa nightclub fire: Luthra brothers offer to compensate victims’ families ₹15 lakh each
news.story_lead: The co-owners of Birch by Romeo Lane, a Goa nightclub where a tragic fire claimed 25 lives, have informed the Bombay High Court at Goa of their willingness to offer ₹15 lakh compensation to each victim's family. The high court is reviewing the offer in a suo motu writ petition following the illegal operation of the club and subsequent safety lapses.
news.full_article_text: The Luthra brothers, co-owners of Birch by Romeo Lane where a devastating fire claimed 25 lives last year, have told the Bombay High Court at Goa that they are willing to compensate the family of each victim with ₹15 lakh. The high court, which instituted a suo motu writ petition after the fire at the illegally operating club, has given the families until October 12 to reply to the offer before a final decision is taken. Advocate General Devidas Pangam noted that this proposed compensation is over and above the financial assistance paid by the government to the affected families. Of the 25 victims, 20 were employees of Being G S Hospitality Arpora LLP, who were working in the basement kitchen when the fire broke out, leaving them trapped without an escape route, while five were guest tourists. Following the incident, the brothers had fled to Phuket in Thailand but were subsequently deported after their passports were suspended and an Interpol notice was issued. They were arrested on December 16 and remain in judicial custody. A chargesheet highlights gross criminal negligence, lack of statutory and safety norms, and a second FIR has been registered against the Luthras and Ajay Gupta for alleged cheating and forgery relating to fabricated documents.
news.background_context: The incident occurred on the intervening night of December 6 and 7, 2025, at an illegally operating nightclub named Birch by Romeo Lane in Arpora, Goa. The fire resulted in 25 fatalities, predominantly employees working in the basement kitchen. The co-owners fled the country immediately after the blaze but were repatriated through international cooperation and law enforcement action.

news.headline: Stabbed flydubai Pilot Smit Machchhar is Indian National and Former SpiceJet Employee
news.story_lead: Smit Machchhar, an Indian national and captain on flydubai's Boeing 737 fleet, was stabbed during a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The Boeing 737 MAX 8 was diverted to Tabuk in north-western Saudi Arabia, where the pilot underwent surgery and is reported to be stable.
news.full_article_text: Captain Smit Machchhar, an Indian national and pilot for flydubai, was injured in a stabbing incident aboard flydubai flight FZ1073 travelling from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The aircraft, a Boeing 737 MAX 8, transmitted a transponder code for unlawful interference and was diverted to Tabuk Airport in north-western Saudi Arabia. Machchhar and his co-pilot were taken to hospital following the incident, where Machchhar underwent surgery and was subsequently reported to be stable. According to his professional background, Machchhar had been a captain on flydubai's Boeing 737 fleet since June 2022, following an 11-year tenure at SpiceJet in Mumbai where he served as a senior commander and line training captain. The flight was secured by on-duty flydubai crew and additional personnel on board, allowing it to land safely at Tabuk Airport. Authorities and the airline have stated that the underlying reasons and motives are subject to a formal investigation.
news.background_context: Smit Machchhar has logged extensive flying hours, including experience on the 737-800 and 737 MAX 8 and 9 models, and previously worked for 11 years at SpiceJet in Mumbai before joining flydubai as a direct-entry captain in June 2022. His brother also works as a pilot with Akasa Air.

news.story_lead: An Indian pilot-in-command, Smit Machchhar, was stabbed during a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv, leading to an emergency diversion to Saudi Arabia. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu praised Captain Machchhar and passengers for their bravery in preventing a major disaster.
news.full_article_text: A freak security incident occurred aboard Flydubai flight FZ1073 traveling from Dubai in the United Arab Emirates to Tel Aviv, Israel. The pilot-in-command, identified as Indian national Smit Machchhar, was reportedly stabbed by the first officer during the flight. Following an emergency alert, the Boeing 737 MAX 8 aircraft sharply descended from 33,000 feet and made an erratic turn near the Jordanian border, prompting Israel to scramble warplanes fearing a hijacking. The aircraft ultimately landed safely in Tabuk, northwestern Saudi Arabia, about an hour after the distress call. Passengers and crew members, including Assaf Rajuan and Shota Musaev, intervened to restrain the attacker using zip ties and headphone cords after the cockpit door was opened. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu saluted Captain Machchhar for his extraordinary bravery, stating that despite being seriously injured, he fought back, opened the cockpit door, and enabled passengers and crew to overpower the attacker, thereby saving 174 lives and preventing a catastrophic mid-air disaster. Saudi authorities arrested the pilot who carried out the stabbing, and investigations are currently underway.

Jaishankar remarked that the United States previously expected India to limit its diplomatic options and focus primarily on Washington. news.headline: Arunachal: Vehicles torched, MLA’s residence vandalised during Siang dam project protests
news.story_lead: Protests against Arunachal Pradesh's proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project intensified as demonstrators clashed with security forces, vandalised a local MLA's residence, and set vehicles on fire. The agitation centers around opposition to survey activities for the over 10,000-MW hydropower project on the Siang river. Chief Minister Pema Khandu maintained that the pre-feasibility report is intended only to establish technical feasibility.
news.full_article_text: Protests against the deployment of central paramilitary forces for surveys regarding the proposed over 10,000-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) on the Siang river at Beging in Arunachal Pradesh’s East Siang district intensified. Demonstrators blocked roads, clashed with security personnel, and allegedly vandalised the residence of Tuting-Yingkiong MLA Alo Libang during Chief Minister Pema Khandu’s visit to Yingkiong. The agitation disrupted traffic along the Yingkiong-Komkar-Geku stretch and towards Dite Dime. Protesters erected blockades, resulting in the vandalisation of the MLA's premises, damage to government vehicles, and a police vehicle being set ablaze near Dite Dime. Security personnel intercepted protest rallies, leading to scuffles. Protesters also restricted movement outside a hotel where Deputy Chief Minister Chowna Mein and other ministers were staying. Upper Siang deputy commissioner Ashok Tajo confirmed that Khandu completed his official meeting before leaving the district by helicopter. Opposition to the PFR has continued in Geku, Komkar, and adjoining areas, driven by concerns over potential displacement of at least 100,000 residents, loss of ancestral and customary land, livelihoods, cultural identity, and environmental consequences. The Siang Indigenous Farmers’ Forum (SIFF) declined an invitation for talks during Khandu's visit. Chief Minister Khandu maintained that the pre-feasibility report (PFR) does not amount to approving construction and is meant to establish technical feasibility over an expected three-month period. The state government has constituted an Empowered High-Level Committee to oversee the process. Meanwhile, in December 2024, China approved a massive hydropower dam on the Tibetan plateau, raising downstream concerns.
news.background_context: The protests involve local communities, notably sections of the indigenous Adi community opposing the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) in Arunachal Pradesh. The project involves pre-feasibility report (PFR) surveys for a 10,000-MW hydropower initiative on the Siang river. Additionally, international context includes China's December 2024 approval of a massive hydropower dam on the lower reaches of the Yarlung Tsangpo on the Tibetan plateau.

news.headline: Bank holidays in October 2026: Full list of public, festival holidays across India
news.story_lead: October 2026 will see multiple bank holidays across India due to national and regional festivals. According to the Reserve Bank of India's holiday calendar, branches will remain closed on several days, including October 2 for Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti.
news.full_article_text: October 2026 will bring a series of bank holidays across India, with branches set to remain shut on several days due to national and regional festivals. While some holidays will apply nationwide, others will be limited to specific states and cities, particularly during the Dussehra and Durga Puja period. According to the Reserve Bank of India's holiday calendar, banks will remain closed on October 2 for Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti, followed by a series of regional holidays later in the month. Customers planning branch visits should check the dates applicable to their city. In addition, all scheduled and non-scheduled banks will remain closed on all Sundays, and the second and fourth Saturdays of the month.
news.background_context: The Reserve Bank of India regulates bank operating schedules and releases annual holiday calendars specifying national and regional closures for scheduled and non-scheduled banks.

news.headline: Religion not under threat in UP, people are: Chandra Shekhar Azad
news.story_lead: Aazad Samaj Party national president and Nagina MP Chandra Shekhar Azad addressed a rally in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, stating that citizens rather than religion are under threat in the state. He emphasized that political discourse should focus on basic public concerns such as education, healthcare, employment, security, and dignity.
news.full_article_text: Addressing a rally in Bareilly in support of party leader Achchan Ansari, Aazad Samaj Party national president and Nagina MP Chandra Shekhar Azad asserted that the primary concerns of ordinary people—education, healthcare, employment, security, and dignity—should take precedence over religious issues in political discourse. Azad criticized the state of government schools, stating improvements would only occur when policymakers and officials enrolled their children in them. On healthcare, he stressed that access to health services is a citizen's right and that the government must ensure adequate medical staff and facilities in public hospitals. Discussing employment, he suggested that Bareilly could develop industrial opportunities akin to Noida, Gurugram, and Mumbai to curb youth migration. He also advocated for dignified remuneration for ASHA and anganwadi workers, improved working conditions for police personnel including an eight-hour duty system and weekly offs, and equal application of the law regarding crime and justice. Following the rally, Azad held a roadshow with supporters.
news.background_context: The remarks were made by Aazad Samaj Party national president and Nagina MP Chandra Shekhar Azad during a political rally in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, addressing everyday public concerns and governance issues.
bullet_points: Chandra Shekhar Azad stated that people, not religion, are under threat in Uttar Pradesh.
He emphasized the need to prioritize basic issues like education, healthcare, employment, security, and dignity.
Azad argued that government schools would improve only if children of officials and ministers studied in them.
He called for proper medical facilities, doctors, and medicines in government hospitals.
He advocated for industrial development in Bareilly to prevent youth migration for jobs.
He demanded dignified remuneration for ASHA and anganwadi workers, and better working conditions for police personnel.
key_facts: Chandra Shekhar Azad is the national president of the Aazad Samaj Party and MP for Nagina.
The rally was held in Bareilly in support of party leader Achchan Ansari.
Azad called for an eight-hour duty system and a weekly day off for police personnel.
He raised concerns regarding paper leaks and youth unemployment.

It touches upon governance accountability, public service delivery, and labor welfare for grassroots workers and law enforcement.

hindi_translation.story_lead: आजाद समाज पार्टी के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष और नगीना से सांसद चंद्रशेखर आजाद ने बुधवार को उत्तर प्रदेश में धार्मिक मुद्दों की राजनीति पर निशाना साधते हुए कहा कि राज्य में धर्म नहीं, बल्कि लोग खतरे में हैं।

bullet_points: चंद्रशेखर आजाद ने कहा कि उत्तर प्रदेश में धर्म नहीं बल्कि लोग खतरे में हैं।
उन्होंने शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, रोजगार और सुरक्षा जैसे बुनियादी मुद्दों पर जोर दिया।

news.headline: Israel's Netanyahu hails Indian pilot Smit Machchar's heroics in saving 174 lives aboard flydubai aircraft
news.story_lead: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has praised Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchar for his extraordinary bravery after he was stabbed by his Omani co-pilot mid-air on a flydubai flight. Despite serious injuries, Captain Machchar managed to open the cockpit door, enabling passengers and crew to overpower the attacker and safely land the aircraft carrying 174 people.
news.full_article_text: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu paid tribute to Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchar's extraordinary bravery for opening the cockpit door on time despite being stabbed by his Omani co-pilot mid-air. The incident occurred on Wednesday, September 30 evening, aboard flydubai flight FZ1073 travelling from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The co-pilot attacked Captain Machchar intending to crash the aircraft. Despite being seriously injured, Machchar opened the locked cockpit door, allowing passengers and crew to overpower the attacker. Two flydubai pilots who were travelling as passengers, along with passengers like Yaniv Hayoun, intervened to take control of the aircraft and landed it safely in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. All 174 passengers and crew members, apart from Captain Machchar, remained safe. In the wake of the incident, flydubai announced the temporary suspension of its daily scheduled flights between Dubai and Tel Aviv for six days pending an investigation by authorities.
news.background_context: The incident involved flydubai flight FZ1073 operating from Dubai to Tel Aviv on Wednesday, September 30. The flight faced a major security threat when the Omani co-pilot allegedly attacked the pilot mid-air, leading to emergency intervention by passengers and off-duty pilots, and an eventual safe landing in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.

news.headline: Centre hikes rabi MSPs for 2027-28 to boost oilseeds; wheat raised by ₹25
news.story_lead: The Centre has raised the minimum support prices (MSPs) for all six Rabi crops for the 2027–28 marketing season, granting the largest absolute hikes to oilseeds and pulses. Safflower received the highest absolute hike of ₹675 per quintal, while wheat saw the smallest increase of ₹25 per quintal.
news.full_article_text: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA), chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, has raised the minimum support prices (MSPs) for all six Rabi crops for the 2027–28 marketing season. The decisions aim to encourage crop diversification towards pulses and oilseeds and ensure remunerative returns to farmers. Safflower received the largest absolute hike of ₹675 per quintal, bringing its MSP to ₹7,215, followed by rapeseed and mustard with a ₹413 increase to ₹6,613 per quintal. Lentil (masur) saw an increase of ₹390 to ₹7,390 per quintal, barley was raised by ₹136 to ₹2,286 per quintal, and gram prices increased by ₹83 to ₹5,958 per quintal. In contrast, wheat received the smallest increase of ₹25, raising its MSP from ₹2,585 to ₹2,610 per quintal. Despite the modest hike, wheat holds the highest margin over its all-India weighted average cost of production at 106%. The cabinet approved a total amount of ₹90,962 crore for this procurement. The modest increase in wheat is attributed to elevated government stocks, with Food Corporation of India (FCI) wheat stocks up over 44% from the previous year.
news.background_context: The MSP revisions align with the government's Budget 2018-19 commitment to fix MSPs at least 1.5 times the all-India weighted average cost of production. The announcement comes ahead of a Rabi season facing climate uncertainties, with agriculture minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan urging states to align crop plans with water availability and soil moisture.

news.headline: Supreme Court Raps Uttar Pradesh Police Over 'Cover-Up Job' In Criminal Investigation
news.story_lead: The Supreme Court of India strongly reprimanded the Uttar Pradesh Police over serious irregularities in a criminal investigation. A two-judge bench warned that the police force could face being disbanded and investigations transferred to the CBI if biased investigation practices continue.
news.full_article_text: The Supreme Court of India came down heavily on the Uttar Pradesh Police over a biased investigation and ordered the officer in charge to explain the irregularities in the next hearing. While hearing a matter on Wednesday, a two-judge bench comprising Justices Sanjay Kumar and Sanjeev Sachdeva warned the UP Police that it could potentially be disbanded and all criminal cases in the state handed over to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) if the 'nonsense' does not stop. The bench expressed deep concern over procedural lapses, such as registering an FIR against unknown persons despite the complainant physically apprehending and handing over the rider of a motorcycle involved in the incident. The court questioned the integrity of investigations where accused individuals caught at the spot are initially omitted from the FIR, only to have their names later inserted in chargesheets or given clean chits. The Supreme Court has directed the officer in charge of the case to be personally present at the next hearing to clarify why the rider's name was missing from the initial FIR and subsequently disclosed in an affidavit.
news.background_context: The Supreme Court's remarks came during the hearing of a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) filed by a complainant over an incident involving a motorcycle, where the complainant alleged that the UP Police deliberately registered an FIR against unknown persons despite physically handing over the apprehended rider to the police.

hindi_translation.headline: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने आपराधिक जांच में 'लीपापोती' को लेकर यूपी पुलिस को फटकारा
hindi_translation.story_lead: भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने आपराधिक जांच के दौरान गंभीर अनियमितताओं को लेकर उत्तर प्रदेश पुलिस को कड़ी फटकार लगाई है। दो न्यायाधीशों की पीठ ने चेतावनी दी कि यदि पक्षपातपूर्ण जांच प्रथाओं को रोका नहीं गया, तो पुलिस बल को भंग किया जा सकता है और जांच सीबीआई को सौंपी जा सकती है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने एक पक्षपातपूर्ण जांच को लेकर उत्तर प्रदेश पुलिस की कड़ी आलोचना की है और मामले की अगली सुनवाई में अधिकारी को अनियमितताओं स्पष्ट करने का आदेश दिया है। बुधवार को एक मामले की सुनवाई करते हुए न्यायमूर्ति संजय कुमार और न्यायमूर्ति संजीव सचदेवा की दो सदस्यीय पीठ ने यूपी पुलिस को चेतावनी दी कि यदि यह 'बकवास' बंद नहीं हुई तो उसे भंग किया जा सकता है और राज्य के सभी आपराधिक मामलों को केंद्रीय जांच ब्यूरो (सीबीआई) को सौंपा जा सकता है। पीठ ने प्रक्रियागत कमियों को लेकर गहरी चिंता व्यक्त की, जैसे कि एक मोटरसाइकिल से जुड़ी घटना के संबंध में शिकायतकर्ता द्वारा पकड़े जाने और पुलिस को सौंपे जाने के बावजूद अज्ञात व्यक्तियों के खिलाफ प्राथमिकी दर्ज करना। सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने मामले के प्रभारी अधिकारी को व्यक्तिगत रूप से अगली सुनवाई में उपस्थित रहने का निर्देश दिया है ताकि यह स्पष्ट किया जा सके कि प्रारंभिक प्राथमिकी से आरोपी का नाम क्यों गायब था और बाद में शपथ पत्र में इसका खुलासा क्यों किया गया।
hindi_translation.background_context: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की यह टिप्पणी एक मोटरसाइकिल से जुड़ी घटना को लेकर एक शिकायतकर्ता द्वारा दायर जनहित याचिका (PIL) पर सुनवाई के दौरान आई, जिसमें शिकायतकर्ता ने आरोप लगाया कि आरोपी को मौके पर पकड़े जाने के बावजूद यूपी पुलिस ने जानबूझकर अज्ञात व्यक्तियों के खिलाफ प्राथमिकी दर्ज की।
bullet_points: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने आपराधिक जांच के दौरान गंभीर अनियमितताओं के लिए उत्तर प्रदेश पुलिस को फटकार लगाई।
दो जजों की बेंच ने चेतावनी दी कि यूपी पुलिस को भंग किया जा सकता है और मामले सीबीआई को सौंपे जा सकते हैं।

news.headline: Madras High Court Refuses to Transfer Veeramani POCSO Case to CBI, Directs SIT to Continue Probe
news.story_lead: The Madras High Court has declined to transfer the investigation into a POCSO case involving granite baron R. Veeramani to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI). The court stated that the Special Investigation Team (SIT) constituted by the Tamil Nadu government must be given adequate time to collect evidence and conduct its probe.
news.full_article_text: The Madras High Court on Wednesday refused to transfer the ongoing investigation of a Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act case involving granite baron R. Veeramani to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI). Justice V. Lakshminarayanan emphasized that the Special Investigation Team (SIT), which was formed four days prior and comprises four women officers, had already commenced its investigation and required time to collect evidence. The court noted that transferring the probe without granting the SIT breathing space or an opportunity to investigate would be improper. R. Veeramani and two of his aides, Mahendra Simhan and his wife Shanti, were previously arrested by the Anti-Vice Squad on August 28 under the POCSO Act after the Intelligence and Technology Police Unit received a USB drive containing video clips showing the alleged sexual assault of minors. A local journalist, Vaaraki, had petitioned the high court seeking the transfer of the probe to the CBI, expressing apprehension that independent investigations would not be carried out. The High Court dismissed these concerns as premature and a form of publicity interest litigation, advising against politicizing sensitive matters involving children. The court directed the petitioner to appear before the SIT on October 1 to submit any relevant material in his possession.
news.background_context: The case involves granite baron R. Veeramani and two caretakers, Mahendra Simhan and his wife Shanti, who were arrested on August 28 by the Anti-Vice Squad under the POCSO Act. The arrests followed the recovery of a USB drive containing video clips received by the Intelligence and Technology Police Unit. A petition was subsequently filed in the Madras High Court by a local journalist seeking a CBI probe, which the court declined, supporting the newly formed state Special Investigation Team instead.

news.headline: Nitin Gadkari expresses ambition to make India's automotive industry world's number one at HT Auto Awards
news.story_lead: Union Transport Minister Nitin Gadkari stated at the HT Auto Awards that India's automotive sector contributes over ₹22.75 lakh crore to the economy. He expressed his dream of making India's automotive industry the largest in the world, surpassing the US and China. The event also highlighted advancements in the ethanol economy and alternative mobility solutions.
news.full_article_text:
Speaking at the inaugural HT Auto Leaderboard Awards 2026, Union Minister Nitin Gadkari stated that India's automotive industry has the potential to become the largest globally, highlighting its position as a key engine of economic growth. Currently, the US holds the top spot, followed by China in second place, with India ranking third. The sector contributes over ₹22.75 lakh crore to the economy, serving as a vital pillar of the country's industrial ecosystem.

During the event, Gadkari highlighted the success of India's ethanol economy. Since 2022, four crore four-wheelers and 20 crore two-wheelers have operated on E20 petrol without reported complaints. Following a phased rollout, E20 (a blend of 20% ethanol and 80% petrol) became the standard petrol variant at fuel pumps across the country starting April 2026. Domestically produced ethanol, derived from crops like sugarcane, maize, and surplus rice, is procured at stable, pre-agreed prices, insulating consumers from global crude price fluctuations and helping lower per-litre petrol costs.

The awards also featured panel discussions addressing India's readiness to become a global auto powerhouse, mobility energy mixes including ethanol and electric vehicles, and emerging technologies in the transportation sector.

news.headline: ED arrests promoter and chairman of Gurugram-based Vatika Group in money laundering case
news.story_lead: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has arrested Anil Bhalla, chairman-cum-managing director, and Gautam Bhalla, promoter of Gurugram-based Vatika Group. The arrests were made under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) in connection with an alleged fraud involving homebuyers.
news.full_article_text: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has taken into custody the promoter and the chairman of Gurugram-based realty firm Vatika Group under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA). Anil Bhalla (chairman-cum-managing director) and Gautam Bhalla (promoter) were arrested on Monday and produced before a special court in the city. The central agency's probe stems from a Delhi Police first information report (FIR) against the Vatika Group and its promoters, which alleges fraudulent inducement, non-delivery of residential plots, and related offenses. According to the ED, Anil Bhalla personally supervised key decisions in the investigated transactions, while Gautam Bhalla executed important agreements, held directorships in land-owning entities, and managed operations. Between 2010 and 2012, seven purchaser entities paid about ₹260 crore upfront to Vatika Limited for residential plots in Vatika India Next and Vatika India Next-2 projects in Gurugram. Plot-wise agreements were executed in 2014 and 2015, after which project layouts were revised, plots were renumbered or relocated, and project land continued to be allotted and sold to different purchasers. The agency noted that in Vatika India Next-2, not a single plot out of about 1.10 lakh sq. yds. purchased for ₹90 crore has been delivered even after about 14 years, while delivery in Vatika India Next has been only partial, leaving substantial portions valued at approximately ₹140.73 crore undelivered.
news.background_context: The investigation originates from a Delhi Police FIR registered against Vatika Group and its promoters. The case involves allegations of fraudulent inducement, non-delivery of residential plots, and related offenses concerning the Vatika India Next and Vatika India Next-2 projects in Gurugram.

news.headline: Tigress from Bihar’s Valmiki Tiger Reserve to be introduced at Bengal’s Buxa on Oct 2
news.story_lead: A three-year-old tigress was flown from Bihar’s Valmiki Tiger Reserve to West Bengal’s Buxa Tiger Reserve as part of the state's first tiger reintroduction initiative. The big cat is scheduled to be released into the reserve's core zone on October 2, following years of habitat restoration and prey base enhancement.
news.full_article_text: A three-year-old tigress was flown in from Bihar’s Valmiki Tiger Reserve to West Bengal’s Buxa Tiger Reserve (BTR) on Wednesday, nearly eight years after the National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) reported no tigers in Buxa. This marks the first tiger reintroduction in West Bengal. Officials stated that plans are underway to bring in at least six more tigers to BTR over the next two years. The tigress arrived at the Hasimara air force base and was transported by road to the reserve in a special animal transport vehicle. The reintroduction follows extensive restoration efforts, including increasing the prey base by releasing around 870 chital deer from various zoos and parks across the state, relocating villages, opening up dense forest canopy to promote grassland growth, and improving water availability and overall forest health. The tigress has been radio-collared for continuous monitoring. Meanwhile, tourism in the BTR has been suspended for four days starting September 30. West Bengal currently has a population of around 100 tigers in the Sunderbans.
news.background_context: The 'Status of Tigers in India – 2018' report published by the NTCA recorded no tigers in three reserves, including Buxa, Dampa, and Palamau, while noting that tigers could be repopulated after restoring the prey base and habitat. Buxa Tiger Reserve was created in 1983 and is contiguous with Bhutan's Phipsu Wildlife Sanctuary and Assam's Manas National Park, serving as an international corridor for wildlife migration.

news.headline: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari urges auto industry to lower EV prices in consumers' interest
news.story_lead: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari urged automobile manufacturers to reduce electric vehicle (EV) prices, noting that lithium-ion battery costs have dropped significantly. Speaking at the HT Auto Leaderboard Awards 2026, he emphasized that wider EV adoption and rising production will naturally drive down costs through market competition.
news.full_article_text: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari urged automobile manufacturers on Wednesday to reduce the prices of electric vehicles (EVs) in the interest of consumers. He highlighted that while the cost of lithium-ion batteries has dropped from USD 150 to USD 50 per kilowatt-hour since the government's push for EVs began, vehicle prices have remained high because demand currently outstrips supply. Speaking at the inaugural HT Auto Leaderboard Awards 2026, Gadkari predicted that rising production, improved quality, and intensifying competition would eventually force companies to lower rates. He stated that electric mobility is the future and reiterated the aim to make India a global export hub for the automotive sector built on quality and safety. Gadkari also noted the success of Bharat NCAP (New Car Safety Assessment Programme) in providing star ratings to automobiles and contributing to the export market. Furthermore, he highlighted the progress of India's ethanol-based economy, mentioning that since 2022, four crore four-wheelers and 20 crore two-wheelers have been running on E20 petrol without complaints. The automotive sector currently contributes ₹ 22.75 lakh crore to the Indian economy.
news.background_context: The context involves India's ongoing transition toward green mobility through electric vehicles and ethanol blending. The government has promoted EVs and alternative fuels to reduce dependence on fossil fuel imports and position India as a global automotive manufacturing and export hub.

Addressing high EV costs through market competition and technological scaling is crucial for inclusive green energy transition.

news.headline: Ranchi PMLA Court Frames Charges Against Jharkhand CM Hemant Soren in 8.86-Acre Land Fraud Case
news.story_lead: A special Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) court in Ranchi has framed charges against Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren under Section 3 of the PMLA in connection with an alleged 8.86-acre land fraud case. The development paves the way for the trial to enter the evidence stage, following the Jharkhand High Court's refusal to stay the proceedings.
news.full_article_text: A special Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) court in Ranchi framed charges against Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren under Section 3 of the PMLA in an alleged 8.86-acre land fraud case, paving the way for a formal trial. The case relates to the alleged illegal acquisition and transfer of land in the Bargain area of Ranchi. Besides Soren, 16 other individuals have been named as accused in the matter. The court framing came hours after the Jharkhand High Court declined to entertain Soren's plea seeking an immediate stay on the trial court's proceedings. Appearing virtually via video conferencing before Special PMLA Court Judge Yougesh Kumar, Soren firmly pleaded innocence against all allegations. Meanwhile, the defence counsel has challenged the constitutionality of Section 44(1)(d) of the PMLA Act in a writ petition before the High Court, which has issued notices to the Central Government and the Enforcement Directorate (ED) to submit their responses.
news.background_context: The case involves allegations of illegal acquisition and transfer of an 8.86-acre land parcel located in the Bargain area of Ranchi, Jharkhand. The Enforcement Directorate (ED) initiated proceedings under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), leading to the recent framing of charges by a special PMLA court.

news.headline: India-US economic ties moving beyond trade to investment, tech, innovation: Piyush Goyal
news.story_lead: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal stated during a business roundtable in Milwaukee that India-US economic relations are expanding beyond traditional trade. The partnership now encompasses advanced manufacturing, technology, innovation, and resilient supply chains.
news.full_article_text: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal, during his visit to Milwaukee for the G20 Trade Ministers' meeting, highlighted the growing momentum in India-US economic ties. Addressing a business roundtable hosted by the National Association of Manufacturers (NAM), Goyal invited American manufacturers to deepen their presence in India, partner with Indian small and medium enterprises (SMEs), and co-invest in advanced manufacturing. He emphasized that the economic relationship is moving beyond traditional trade to include investment, manufacturing, technology, innovation, and resilient supply chains. Goyal also attended a reception at Rockwell Automation's global headquarters and held engagements with executives, G20 trade ministers, and the Indian diaspora in Chicago. Discussions also focus on advancing a balanced India-US bilateral trade agreement (BTA) and addressing preferential tariff frameworks.
news.background_context: India and the US had reached a framework for an interim bilateral trade agreement (BTA) in February, though the agreement was not signed after the US Supreme Court invalidated the legal basis for the preferential tariff mechanism Washington had offered. India is awaiting a preferential tariff framework that provides competitive access for exporters.

news.headline: Amit Shah pledges to eradicate synthetic drugs from Punjab by December 2029 if BJP is voted to power
news.story_lead: Union home minister Amit Shah pledged during a rally in Jalandhar that the BJP, if voted to power in Punjab next year, will eliminate the trade of synthetic drugs ("chitta") from the state by December 31, 2029. The statement marked the culmination of the state BJP unit's 13-day "Nasha Mukt Punjab Yatra" at Kot Kalan village.
news.full_article_text: Union home minister Amit Shah announced during a rally at Jalandhar’s Kot Kalan village that the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) will fight the upcoming Punjab assembly elections solely on the issue of a drug-free state. Concluding the state BJP unit’s 13-day “Nasha Mukt Punjab Yatra,” Shah pledged that a BJP government would eradicate synthetic drugs, locally known as “chitta,” by December 31, 2029. Shah criticized the ruling Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) administration in Punjab, accusing it of allowing the open proliferation of the drug trade, failing to arrest peddlers under the state's anti-narcotics act, and declining permission to establish a Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) unit in the state. He also cited the central government's record in eradicating terrorism in Jammu & Kashmir and Northeastern states, alongside Naxalism, as proof of execution ahead of deadlines. In response, AAP criticized the central leadership, pointing to a massive drug seizure in Gujarat and suggesting that the Centre should focus on national drug networks rather than targeting Punjab.
news.background_context: The state BJP unit organized a 13-day "Nasha Mukt Punjab Yatra" starting September 18, which concluded with a rally at Kot Kalan village in Jalandhar. Drug addiction and the trafficking of synthetic drugs like 'chitta' remain major socio-political issues in Punjab.
bullet_points: Union home minister Amit Shah pledged to eradicate synthetic drugs ("chitta") from Punjab by December 31, 2029, if the BJP is voted to power next year.
The announcement was made during a rally at Kot Kalan village in Jalandhar, marking the culmination of the 13-day "Nasha Mukt Punjab Yatra."

key_facts: Amit Shah pledged to eradicate 'chitta' from Punjab by December 31, 2029.

hindi_translation.headline: अमित शाह ने वादा किया कि अगर अगले साल बीजेपी सत्ता में आई तो दिसंबर 2029 तक पंजाब से नशों को खत्म कर दिया जाएगा

hindi_translation.full_article_text: केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने बुधवार को जालंधर के कोट कलां गांव में एक रैली के दौरान घोषणा की कि यदि भाजपा पंजाब में सत्ता में आती है, तो वह राज्य को नशा मुक्त बनाएगी। यह रैली राज्य भाजपा इकाई की 13 दिवसीय "नशा मुक्त पंजाब यात्रा" के समापन पर आयोजित की गई थी। शाह ने कहा कि भाजपा इस चुनाव को पूरी तरह से नशा मुक्त पंजाब के मुद्दे पर लड़ेगी और आप सरकार पर ड्रग व्यापार को बढ़ावा देने का आरोप लगाया।
hindi_translation.background_context: पंजाब में नशीली दवाओं की समस्या और 'चिट्टा' का व्यापार एक प्रमुख सामाजिक-राजनीतिक मुद्दा बना हुआ है।

news.headline: Haryana seeks to drive next chapter of auto industry with EVs, batteries, and R&D: Minister Arvind Sharma
news.story_lead: Haryana cabinet minister Arvind Sharma stated that the state aims to spearhead the next phase of India's automotive sector by prioritizing electric vehicle (EV) manufacturing, battery production, advanced components, and research and development (R&D). Speaking at the HT Auto Leaderboard Awards 2026, he highlighted the state's robust industrial ecosystem and recent policy incentives for cleaner mobility.
news.full_article_text: Haryana cabinet minister Arvind Sharma announced that the state is positioning itself to drive the next chapter of India's automotive industry by focusing on electric vehicle (EV) manufacturing, battery production, advanced components, and research and development (R&D). Speaking at the inaugural HT Auto Leaderboard Awards 2026, Sharma emphasized that Haryana has established itself as one of India's premier automotive hubs, backed by a strong network of original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), component makers, and global suppliers spanning Gurugram, Manesar, Bawal, Rewari, and Faridabad. Noting that future vehicles will rely heavily on batteries, electronics, and software alongside engines, Sharma outlined the state's policy framework aimed at ensuring the next generation of mobility is designed and built in Haryana. As part of its push toward cleaner mobility, the state government approved a 100% motor vehicle tax exemption for eligible electric vehicles priced up to ₹30 lakh, and a 50% exemption for vehicles priced above that threshold. Additionally, the state's 2026 industrial policy framework targets investment, manufacturing, employment, and future-ready development to attract global companies. Sharma also underscored the importance of human capital, stressing the need to reskill the existing workforce and train young people in emerging technologies like artificial intelligence, connected vehicles, and advanced manufacturing to ensure an inclusive transition.
news.background_context: Haryana has built a robust automotive ecosystem comprising OEMs, component makers, and global suppliers across regions like Gurugram, Manesar, Bawal, Rewari, and Faridabad, supported by skilled workers and connectivity.
bullet_points: Haryana aims to drive the next phase of India's auto industry focusing on EVs, batteries, advanced components, and R&D.
The state features a robust automotive ecosystem across Gurugram, Manesar, Bawal, Rewari, and Faridabad.
The government approved a 100% motor vehicle tax exemption for eligible EVs priced up to ₹30 lakh and a 50% exemption for higher-priced models.
The 2026 industrial policy push focuses on investment, manufacturing, employment, and future-ready development.
Emphasis is placed on workforce reskilling and training youth in emerging fields like AI and connected vehicles.

Policies targeting EV adoption, battery production, and workforce reskilling are crucial for sustainable economic growth and reducing carbon emissions in the transportation sector.

By implementing targeted tax exemptions for electric vehicles and updating industrial policies for 2026, the state aims to become a global mobility hub while emphasizing inclusive workforce reskilling.

news.headline: Woman arrested for murder of 5-year-old daughter, 3-year-old son in Kerala’s Palakkad
news.story_lead: A day after two siblings were found dead in a water tub inside the bathroom of their rented home in Menonpara, Kerala, police arrested their mother for murder. The accused mother initially claimed she found the children dead while busy with work, but later confessed to drowning them during police questioning.
news.full_article_text: A day after two siblings, aged five and three, were found dead in a water tub inside the bathroom of their rented home in Menonpara in Kerala’s Palakkad district, their mother was arrested for murder, police said. Jennifer Juliet (5) and her brother Robin Christopher (3) were found dead in the water tub around 10:30 am on Tuesday in Kozhinjampara. The mother, Nivedya, had initially told police that she was busy with work and found her children dead after going inside the bathroom, while the children's father, John Kumar, was out for work. Initially, police filed a case of unnatural death and conducted inquests and postmortems. However, after taking statements from locals, neighbours, and the father, who expressed doubts about Nivedya's account, police questioned her on Wednesday. During questioning, Nivedya confessed to drowning her children, claiming they were a hindrance to her desire to lead a free, independent life, study, and pursue a modelling career. Police have recorded her confession and are continuing a comprehensive investigation.
news.background_context: The incident took place in Menonpara, Kozhinjampara, located in Kerala’s Palakkad district. Local police registered an FIR and initially handled the case as an unnatural death before proceeding with murder charges based on statements and subsequent confession.

news.headline: CBI Drops Dowry Act Charges in Initial Chargesheet of Twisha Sharma Case
news.story_lead: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has dropped dowry harassment charges against retired judge Giribala Singh in the Twisha Sharma suicide case. The development was informed to the Madhya Pradesh High Court by Singh's lawyer during a bail plea hearing. The case involves the death by suicide of model Twisha Sharma on May 12, 2026, five months after her marriage.
news.full_article_text: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has dropped the dowry harassment charge against retired judge Giribala Singh, an accused in the Twisha Sharma suicide case, according to her lawyer Surendra Singh. The submission was made before the Madhya Pradesh High Court while seeking bail for Giribala, who is currently in jail alongside her son and Twisha’s husband, Samarth Singh. Following the submission, the high court directed the lawyer to file a revised bail application and scheduled the hearing for October 8. Giribala and Samarth were initially booked for abetment to suicide and under the Dowry Prohibition Act following the death of Twisha Sharma, who died by suicide on May 12, 2026, five months after her marriage. A bench of justice Ajay Kumar Nirankari directed the filing of a revised petition since the original application omitted the detail that the CBI did not invoke dowry charges in the chargesheet filed on August 14. According to Giribala’s lawyer, the chargesheet cites offences under sections 85, 108, and 3(5) of the Bhartiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, but lacks evidence for dowry harassment. Meanwhile, Twisha’s advocate Anurag Shrivastava noted that the 600-page chargesheet filed before a special court in Bhopal accuses Samarth and Giribala of sustained psychological harm leading to abetment to suicide, while the probe into dowry demands remains open pending forensic analysis of digital evidence.
news.background_context: Twisha Sharma, a model and wife of Samarth Singh, died by suicide on May 12, 2026. Initially, police registered a case for abetment to suicide and under the Dowry Prohibition Act against Giribala and Samarth. The former judge secured anticipatory bail on May 15 from the Bhopal District and Sessions Court, which was subsequently challenged in the high court. The high court ordered a second post-mortem by a team from AIIMS Delhi, cancelled the anticipatory bail on May 27, and the state government handed over the investigation to the CBI.

news.headline: Delhi records lowest September AQI in five years at 102, highest ‘moderate’ air quality days in 2026
news.story_lead: Delhi recorded its lowest monthly average Air Quality Index (AQI) for September in the last five years, dropping to 102 in 2026. The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change reported improvements in overall air quality metrics, including a higher number of moderate days and lower PM2.5 concentrations compared to previous years.
news.full_article_text: According to the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Delhi recorded a monthly average AQI of 102 in September 2026, marking the lowest September average in the past five years. Previous September averages stood at 105 in 2025, 105 in 2024, 108 in 2023, and 104 in 2022. Additionally, the January-September period of 2026 saw 194 days with a daily average AQI below 200 ('Moderate' category), which is the highest in the last five years compared to 187 days in 2025, 188 days in 2024, 193 days in 2023, and 146 days in 2022. Furthermore, the period recorded 79 'Poor to Severe' air quality days, the lowest in five years, compared to 86 days in 2025 and 2024, 80 days in 2023, and 127 days in 2022. The average PM2.5 concentration from January 1 to September 28, 2026, was recorded at 69 µg/m³, matching the 2025 level and down from previous years. The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) is working with stakeholders to intensify anti-pollution measures ahead of the winter season.
news.background_context: Delhi-NCR typically experiences air quality deterioration during the winter season due to meteorological conditions and emission sources, prompting monitoring and regulatory interventions by bodies like the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM).

news.headline: ECI extends SIR schedule in Andhra Pradesh, Meghalaya; new dates announced
news.story_lead: The Election Commission of India (ECI) has extended the schedule for the special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Andhra Pradesh and Meghalaya. According to the official press release, the final electoral rolls are now scheduled to be published on October 16 and October 26, respectively.
news.full_article_text: The Election Commission of India (ECI) has officially extended the timeline for the special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in the states of Andhra Pradesh and Meghalaya. The decision was finalized during a full Commission bench meeting, which marked the second such meeting held in less than a week. In Andhra Pradesh, the notice phase along with the disposal of claims and objections will now take place from July 31 to October 10, setting the final publication date for the electoral roll to October 16. This follows multiple previous revisions to the state's timeline, which initially slated final publication for September 22, then October 3, and later October 9. In Meghalaya, where the claims and objections period concluded on September 18 and over 90% of hearings were reported complete, the final publication date is now set for October 26. These administrative adjustments follow previous ECI decisions to extend SIR deadlines in Delhi and Maharashtra, with the Commission reiterating that its major decisions are made unanimously.
news.background_context: The decision follows a full Commission bench meeting of the Election Commission of India, coming shortly after previous extensions of SIR deadlines in Delhi and Maharashtra. The ECI has reiterated that its major decisions are taken unanimously following prior political controversies and reports of internal disagreements.
bullet_points: The Election Commission of India extended the special intensive revision (SIR) schedule for electoral rolls in Andhra Pradesh and Meghalaya.
In Andhra Pradesh, the final electoral roll will now be published on October 16, with the disposal of claims and objections running until October 10.
In Meghalaya, the final publication of electoral rolls is set for October 26, following the completion of over 90% of hearings on claims and objections.

hindi_translation.headline: ECI ने आंध्र प्रदेश, मेघालय में SIR शेड्यूल बढ़ाया; नई तारीखों की घोषणा
hindi_translation.story_lead: भारत निर्वाचन आयोग (ECI) ने आंध्र प्रदेश और मेघालय में मतदाता सूचियों के विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (SIR) के शेड्यूल को बढ़ा दिया है। आधिकारिक प्रेस विज्ञप्ति के अनुसार, अंतिम मतदाता सूचियां अब क्रमशः 16 अक्टूबर और 26 अक्टूबर को प्रकाशित की जानी हैं।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: भारत निर्वाचन आयोग (ECI) ने आधिकारिक तौर पर आंध्र प्रदेश और मेघालय राज्यों में मतदाता सूचियों के विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (SIR) की समय सीमा बढ़ा दी है। यह निर्णय पूर्ण आयोग की पीठ की बैठक में लिया गया, जो एक हफ्ते से भी कम समय में दूसरी ऐसी बैठक थी। आंध्र प्रदेश में, नोटिस चरण और दावों तथा आपत्तियों का निपटान अब 31 जुलाई से 10 अक्टूबर तक चलेगा, और अंतिम सूची 16 अक्टूबर को प्रकाशित की जाएगी। मेघालय में, अंतिम प्रकाशन अब 26 अक्टूबर के लिए निर्धारित है, जहां दावों और आपत्तियों की अवधि 18 सितंबर को समाप्त हुई थी और अधिकारियों ने बताया कि 90% से अधिक सुनवाई पूरी हो चुकी है।
hindi_translation.background_context: यह निर्णय भारत निर्वाचन आयोग की पूर्ण पीठ की बैठक के बाद आया है, जो दिल्ली और महाराष्ट्र में SIR समय सीमा के पिछले विस्तार के तुरंत बाद आयोजित की गई थी।

आंध्र प्रदेश में अंतिम मतदाता सूची 16 अक्टूबर को प्रकाशित की जाएगी।
मेघालय में अंतिम प्रकाशन 26 अक्टूबर को तय किया गया है।
